newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians protest seizure of land by settlers.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians protest seizure of land by settlers.

text.p: Palestinians held a sit-in on lands north of self-ruled Jericho in the West Bank on Monday to protest against Jewish settlers seizing the site, witnesses said.
Dozens of Palestinians, led by PLO Agriculture Minister Abdel-Jawad Saleh, tried to prevent settlers from plowing the land in Jiftlik, north of Jericho.
"An Israeli army commander asked the people to leave the land, claiming that the area was a military closed area," one witness said.
"We will not leave the land until the settlers leave because their presence here and their attempt to seize the land is a violation of the agreements signed between Israel and the PLO," Saleh said.

On Sunday, witnesses said, settlers tried to seize the uncultivated land of the Jiftlik Agricultural Experimental Station, but when Palestinians protested, Israeli soldiers arrived and drove the Jewish settlers away.
The army said it was checking the report.

According to a deal expanding Palestinian self-rule in the West Bank between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO) a year ago, Jiftlik fell under Israeli security control but was to have been handed over to Palestinian rule in September.
Saleh said under the PLO-Israel peace deals, the land was state land to be left untouched until handed over to the Palestinians.
"This (Israeli) government is not serious about peace because although there is an agreement on this issue, we still see settlers trying to seize the land," Saleh said.
